import re

expense_notes_data = {}
for note_id in expense_note_ids:
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=simple_note_token)
    content = note['content']
    expenses = []

        line = line.strip()
        if line.startswith('- '):
            # Pattern: - Payer paid $amount for "Description". Owed equally by Name1, Name2, ...
            m = re.match(r'- (\w+) paid \$(\d+) for "([^"]+)"\. Owed equally by (.+)\.', line)
            if m:
                payer = m.group(1)
                amount = float(m.group(2))
                desc = m.group(3)
                debtors_str = m.group(4)
                debtors = [name.strip() for name in debtors_str.split(',')]
                expenses.append({
                    'payer': payer,
                    'amount': amount,
                    'description': desc,
                    'debtors': debtors
                })
    expense_notes_data[note_id] = expenses
    print(f"Note {note_id} ({note['title']}):")
    for exp in expenses:
        print(f"  {exp['payer']} paid ${exp['amount']} for {exp['description']} owed by {exp['debtors']}")
